images.title: Corner B on a line
images.purpose: Show that B lies on the line l at C and also 7 cm from D, because the diagonal DB is 7 cm.
images.composition: One figure centred: base, vertical line, one diagonal.
images.exact_structure: Base DC of 5 cm horizontal at the bottom, D left and C right. A vertical line l through C, with a small square mark at C. Point B on l about 4.9 cm above C, marked with an amber #E69F00 dot. Diagonal DB drawn teal #0072B2 and labelled 7 cm. Line l drawn grey #6B7280. Exactly 1 base, 1 line l, 1 point B, 1 diagonal.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A diagonal gives the distance between its two end corners.
images.description: Base DC of 5 cm, a vertical line l at C, point B on l, and the 7 cm diagonal DB in teal.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at B and say it is on l and 7 cm from D.
